rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for agreement, assent, or consent.

example.traditional: 呢個安排得到大家同意。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 dak1 dou2 daai6 gaa1 tung4 ji3

rows.note: Pick this for accepting or welcoming a person, thing, idea, or proposal, especially when emphasizing favorable reception.

example.english: This new proposal got quick acceptance from the school.
example.traditional: 學校好快就接納咗呢個新方案。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 hou2 faai3 zau6 zip3 naap6 zo2 ni1 go3 san1 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this when acceptance means approval or endorsement of an idea, view, or proposal rather than merely receiving it.

example.english: This idea has my full acceptance.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jing6 tung4 nei5 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this formal noun for the degree to which a policy, institution, or decision is socially accepted or regarded as legitimate.

example.english: The acceptance of this policy is still not high enough.
example.traditional: 呢項政策嘅認受性仲未夠高。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 ge3 jing6 sau6 sing3 zung6 mei6 gau3 gou1
